<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<record_update table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>Sync child tasks on update</name><collection>incident</collection><when>after</when><order>100</order><active>true</active><advanced>true</advanced><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_update>true</action_update><script>(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    gs.log('DEBUG sync child tasks for ' + current.number);
    var tasks = new GlideRecord('incident_task');
    tasks.addQuery('incident', current.getUniqueValue());
    tasks.query();
    while (tasks.next()) {
        var grp = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        grp.get(tasks.getValue('assignment_group'));
        tasks.work_notes = 'Parent updated; group ' + grp.getDisplayValue();
        tasks.update();
    }
    current.u_last_sync = new GlideDateTime();
    current.update();
})(current, previous);</script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_id>c0ffee00000000000000000000000001</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope></sys_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>LegacyRoutingUtils</name><api_name>global.LegacyRoutingUtils</api_name><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><script>var LegacyRoutingUtils = Class.create();
LegacyRoutingUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /* Evaluates a routing expression stored on the rule record. */
    route: function(ruleName, current) {
        var rule = new GlideRecord('u_routing_rule');
        rule.addQuery('u_name', ruleName);
        rule.query();
        if (rule.next()) {
            return eval(rule.getValue('u_expression'));
        }
        return null;
    },

    groupsForMembers: function(userIds) {
        var groups = [];
        userIds.forEach(function(id) {
            var m = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
            m.addQuery('user', id);
            m.query();
            while (m.next()) {
                groups.push(m.getValue('group'));
            }
        });
        return groups;
    },

    type: 'LegacyRoutingUtils'
};</script><sys_id>c0ffee00000000000000000000000006</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>WorkOrderHelper</name><api_name>x_demo_fieldsvc.WorkOrderHelper</api_name><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><script>var WorkOrderHelper = Class.create();
WorkOrderHelper.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    assignTechnician: function(workOrder) {
        gs.log('Assigning technician for ' + workOrder.getValue('number'));
        try {
            var tech = new GlideRecord('x_demo_fieldsvc_technician');
            tech.addActiveQuery();
            tech.orderBy('u_open_tasks');
            tech.setLimit(1);
            tech.query();
            if (tech.next()) {
                workOrder.setValue('assigned_to', tech.getValue('user'));
            }
        } catch (err) { /* swallowed */ }
    },

    type: 'WorkOrderHelper'
};</script><sys_id>c0ffee00000000000000000000000007</sys_id><sys_scope display_value="x_demo_fieldsvc">c0ffee00aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa01</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>
